# S247 NBA simulator versus line v2

## Verdict

**CLOSED AT LIMIT.** The required strictly-prior rates snapshot is unavailable for every archive game cluster, so no frozen grid was formed and no simulator, market, or incumbent metric was scored on a qualifying subset.

The two rate files have no embedded as-of date field. Their UTC filesystem dates are both `2026-06-07`, after the latest archive game date (`2026-04-06`); neither file can establish a rate snapshot dated strictly before any archive game. This is an evidence-availability exclusion, not a label about a game.

## Informational premise re-measurement

The specified `_all` archive has 79,554 ticks across 661 game clusters from 2024-10-25 through 2026-04-06. The measured Brier ordering is confirmed.

| Archive | Ticks | Game clusters | Market Brier | Recal-null Brier | Ladder-base Brier |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `_all` | 79,554 | 661 | 0.142876712852 | 0.144293050901 | 0.146849530547 |
| `_rated` | 33,713 | 284 | 0.144100776926 | 0.146842905353 | 0.153323943143 |

The `_rated` companion spans 2024-10-25 through 2025-04-13. No program-memo corpus count is used here.

## Rates limit

The strict predicate is `player_snapshot_date < game_date and team_snapshot_date < game_date`. It returns 0 qualifying clusters out of 661, below the fixed minimum of 30. `scripts/platformkit/ingame/s247_nba_sim_engine_v2.py` imports `src.sim.fast_sim` read-only and enforces this guard before any pricing operation; no simulator call occurs in this result.

| Item | Value |
|---|---:|
| Qualifying game clusters | 0 |
| Excluded game clusters for unavailable as-of rates evidence | 661 |
| Frozen-grid scored ticks | 0 |
| Fixed simulator improvement bar | +0.004 (not evaluated) |
| Game-clustered 95 percent CI | not computed |

## Three-arm result

| Arm | Brier on qualifying frozen grid | ECE on qualifying frozen grid |
|---|---|---|
| Market | not scored; no qualifying clusters | not scored; no qualifying clusters |
| Recal-null incumbent | not scored; no qualifying clusters | not scored; no qualifying clusters |
| Simulator | not scored; no qualifying clusters | not scored; no qualifying clusters |

Simulator improvement and its 95 percent game-clustered CI are not computed. The paired-loss file is intentionally header-only because there are no scored game units, not because any units were removed after scoring.

## Reproduction and invariant checks

- `S247_nba_sim_engine_vs_line_v2_2026-09-04_summary.json` records the zero-count decision and the source hashes.
- `S247_nba_sim_engine_vs_line_v2_2026-09-04_paired_losses.csv` is the required Q9 paired-loss schema with zero rows; a verifier can reproduce the closure from the archive plus the two snapshot metadata dates.
- No Q1 preregistration or Q2 ledger charge applies because no comparison was scored, no simulator result was emitted, and K was not read.
- `src/` was not edited. Its 441-file tree SHA-256 before and after this work is `c049174dad1911b1884e59c461b4a9a7da571210d98dacc7e8cb3b97519d095d`.
- The two S92 archive SHA-256 values above were rechecked after measurement and are unchanged. `backtest_fwer.jsonl`, the register, and the ledger were neither read nor changed.

- Simulator calibration on any archive tick.
- Frozen evenly-spaced tick-grid construction.
- Three-arm Brier or ECE on qualifying clusters.
- Simulator improvement, the fixed bar comparison, or the game-clustered confidence interval.
- A non-empty Q9 paired-loss series.
